text: The fugitive bank robbers Seth and Richie Gecko, leaving bodies behind them in Texas, [kidnap a widowed pastor and his teenage children|who_suffers|families and parents] and force them to drive their motor home into Mexico. They wait out the night at the Titty Twister, an all-night strip club in the desert, until the star dancer Santánico Pandemonium [turns into a monstrous vampire|threat|blood drinkers] at the sight of blood. Barricaded inside with bikers and truckers, the survivors fight back with [a cross pendant, wooden stakes and a cruciform shotgun|rules|faith and charms protect] and wait for dawn.
